knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A shower recess is a wet area that depends on the waterproofing position, so it is referred.
A dry run sets out the first row and avoids narrow edge cuts.
The lesson says the substrate must be flat, sound, clean, dry and firm, and that tiling over a loose, damp, dusty or deflecting surface gives tiles that lift or crack.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated floor, the worker checks the tiles, sets out a dry run, cuts and fixes tiles with spacers, and checks level with a straight edge.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Set-out record with the dry run
stopWorkCriteria: The substrate is loose, damp or dusty and not prepared
A wet area is presented as basic tiling
